chapter: Alan Smithee, Author of Fischl: Epilogue
act_title: Alan Smithee, Author of Fischl: Epilogue

quests.title: Alan Smithee, Author of Fischl: Epilogue

dialogue.t: That's right. Just channel Mr. Nine. How would he write this particular essay, hmm...?
Hey, Chang the Ninth! We have something for you!
What? Where did all this Mora come from!?
About that... So, um, the thing is... Right! Mr. Nine really admires your work, so he decided to fund your writing career!
Wait, what? So... channeling Mr. Nine actually worked!? I can't believe it!

dialogue.sit:
Of course, for Chang the Ninth, wealth pales in comparison to his craft. The matter of Mora is swiftly forgotten as he puts pen back to paper.

Thus, you continue on back to Mondstadt...

quests.description: Now that you’ve learned Mr. Nine’s secret, it’s time to deliver the hidden royalties to Chang the Ninth…
